resumability_rules.campaign_level: On restart, storage.get_completed_campaign_ids() inspects completed campaigns in campaigns/ and skips completed campaign IDs.
resumability_rules.attempt_level: Attack IDs are strictly deterministic (atk_adv002_{campaign}_{round:03d}_{agent_id}) preventing ID collision or mutation.
resumability_rules.memory_protection: ADV-001 attack_memory.jsonl is ingested strictly in read mode ('r'); SHA-256 is verified pre- and post-run.
resumability_rules.evidence_preservation: Final artifacts (metrics.json, adaptation_metrics.json, evidence.md) are generated only upon full completion.

failure_recovery.interrupted_campaign: If interrupted mid-campaign, the partial campaign file is not marked is_completed=True, allowing the scheduler to resume at the target transaction cleanly.
failure_recovery.unhandled_exception_handling: SwarmEvaluator catches individual attempt exceptions and logs terminal outcome='ERROR' with failure provenance rather than crashing the swarm loop.
